checks.name: Ball count bounds and independent clone identities
Four rule presets have fixed counts and a separate cue ball
Eight ball rack has central black and opposite corner groups
Nine ball rack is a diamond with one leading and nine central
Snooker has fifteen reds and six correctly coloured spotted balls
Fifteen ball rack numbers and restart preserve rule
No time elapses before first shot
Pause freezes physics and excludes paused time
Charge cancellation and invalid input never fires
Separating bodies do not receive extra impulse
Aim preview uses expanded collision radius and first obstacle
Shot gating, clock and friction settle deterministically
White pocket does not count as an icon and respawns safely
Pocketing all icons finishes and freezes score time
High-speed play remains bounded and finite
